summary: OrcaRouter's offers page lets you claim live voucher, student, and hackathon API credits (dollar amounts, scope, and expiry are printed on each card at claim time) and call a rotating set of $0 models. Create an account and claim an open offer with no payment method; a few partner offers are labelled card-required. Always-free $0 models are for established accounts (GitHub with some history, or any paid purchase). Promo credit expiry is shown before confirm; $0 models stay free while they remain in the lineup. Docs currently list DeepSeek V4 -free ids and the orcarouter/free router.
claim_steps: Create an account at orcarouter.ai (the offers page says an API key takes 30 seconds; no card, no sales call).
Open orcarouter.ai/offers and claim a live open offer; student/community offers unlock with an eligible email or invite code.
Call rotating $0 models (for example orcarouter/free or a -free catalog id) on the OpenAI-compatible endpoint; link GitHub with history if a free-model request is declined.
